source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Your **PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS**, **ABERRANTS** or **BIOPHAGUS** units get +1 to their **[Charge rolls](vsdata:core-rule/charge-step)**. When one of those units is picked to fight in a turn in which it completed a **Charge move**, the melee weapons of its models gain +1 Attacks until that phase ends.
